doc.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015

title: Is a musician's life easy? Meeting studio demands
summary: Bucky says the musician's life is not easy because studio sessions demand more than you have prepared, and you learn on the job.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: Advice to young musicians starting out

blocks.x: All right here’s one: the life of a musician is easy?
Well I mean we’re expected to do so much every time we appear somewhere, especially on a recording session. And sometimes you don’t meet those specifications.
Sometimes who doesn’t make the specifications?
Well you don’t. Yourself. I mean they want certain things and you have to be ready to do that. So that’s a tough job for a musician.
How do you get that preparation? You just learn it on the job?
Yeah, yeah. They want more than what you have.
Okay. And sometimes do you have producers who don’t really know what they want?
And you give them more than they think they’re getting.
